result.reason: The language generally tracks the preferred transition period and rates, but it does not require data return within 30 days of expiry or termination; the deadline runs only from a Customer request, which could occur later or not at all. More importantly, termination of any single Service Option Attachment triggers return and deletion of all Customer data, potentially disrupting continuing attachments and conflicting with the original clause’s intent that other attachments remain unaffected. The trigger and data scope should be limited to the terminated services, while agreement-wide termination may cover all Customer Data.
